title: Verified HTTPS files
summary: Direct HTTPS files whose sizes and SHA-256 digests are pinned by a dataset manifest.
description: The built-in direct adapter streams an explicitly declared HTTPS file, rejects unsafe paths, enforces the declared size, verifies SHA-256, and only then moves it into the local cache.

resolution.note: URLs and integrity metadata come from the dataset manifest; the registry cannot supply executable downloader code.
